senses.gloss:
a. (Used only at the end of comp.) Who or what goes, going, moving, being, staying, remaining, having sexual intercourse with &c.; cf. [[Ms. 4. 120]]; [[Y. 3. 290]]; [[R. 3. 13.]] 
-गः 
__1 A Gandharva. 
__2 An epithet of Gaṇeśa. 
__3 A long syllable (used as an abbreviation of गुरु, in prosody). 
__4 Śiva. 
__5 Viṣṇu; cf. गः प्रीतो भवः श्रीपतिरुत्तमः [[Enm.]] 
-गा, -गम् A song; गं वादित्रं शरणं वरम् । ibid.

€1 or 2A , 3P. (गाते, जिगाति) 
__1 To go, see इ. etc. 
__2 To come to any state or condition. 
__3 To praise, sing.
A song, verse. ‘गा क्ष्मोमा च रमा । ’ [[Enm.]]
